scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

question: Can the QEC resource score be improved by relabeling the same physical circuit instead of reducing hardware?

adversarial_audit.transformation: map the sorted distinct operational qubit identifiers to contiguous identifiers 0..Q_active-1 without changing instruction order, gate arguments, coordinates, record targets, detector annotations, or observables
required_equivalence: canonical compact circuit bytes are identical
fixed-seed detector and observable samples are byte-identical
MWPM predictions and logical failure vectors are byte-identical

resource_metric_v2.active_physical_qubits: number of distinct qubit identifiers targeted by operational Stim instructions; QUBIT_COORDS-only identifiers do not count
resource_metric_v2.index_span_qubits: Stim circuit.num_qubits, retained as a diagnostic only because it equals max referenced identifier plus one
resource_metric_v2.canonicalization: bind each active qubit to its unique QUBIT_COORDS tuple, order active qubits lexicographically by coordinates, then relabel to 0..Q_active-1 before resource hashing or challenge-seed derivation; reject missing or duplicate coordinate bindings
resource_metric_v2.composite_score: Score_QEC = sqrt(I_X * I_Z) after both strict verification gates pass; otherwise Score_QEC=0
resource_metric_v2.candidate_acceptance: Score_QEC >=1.25, I_X>=1, I_Z>=1, both strict verification gates pass, and no physical or statistical assumption is weakened

challenge_binding_v2.derivation: lower 63 bits of the first eight SHA-256 bytes of UTF8(secret salt) || 0x00 || canonical compact Stim circuit bytes
